title: Amb a 1-Specific IgE in Heart Failure: A Translational Framework for Seasonal Risk, Endotyping, and Patient-Centered Management.
snippet: : Amb a 1 is the major allergenic component ofpollen and a clinically relevant marker of genuine ragweed sensitization. Heart failure is increasingly recognized as a systemic syndrome shaped by immune activation, endothelial dysfunction, fibrosis, neurohormonal imbalance, pulmonary comorbidity, and environmental exposures.
